The fabric appears soft and slightly crumpled, suggesting it is made of cotton or a similar textile. A small tag with the text 'moda baby' is visible on the left side. To rigorously audit the 'moda baby' text for character-level accuracy and detect any subtle glyph anomalies indicative of AI generation.
